raw:
@q query
  select ?c
  select ?l
  where match
    relation "be a dormitory of"
    role subject ?c
    role object "UAIC"
    role location "Codrescu"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?l
  where match
    relation "have"
    role subject ?c
    role object ?l
    polarity affirmed
  end
